title: The description and part number hints disappear when the saved value is typed back and ignore outer spaces
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-B1 (stocked at both locations; note its description {desc}). DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-B1 > add "X" to the end of the Description.
  2. Delete the "X" so the field equals {desc} again.
  3. Add one space before and one after {desc}.
  4. Change the Part Number to "QAPL-B1-X".
  5. Change the Part Number back to "QAPL-B1", then add one space before and one after it.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Reopen QAPL-B1, then open its Part History (row history icon).
custom_expected:
1. text_description_other_locations shows "This also changes the description at 1 other location." under the field.
  2. The hint disappears.
  3. No hint (outer spaces are not a change).
  4. text_part_number_other_locations shows "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."
  5. The hint disappears when "QAPL-B1" is typed back and stays hidden with only the outer spaces.
  6. Saved with no confirmation; POST /api/inventory/parts/change returns 201.
  7. The number reads "QAPL-B1" and the description {desc}, both without the added spaces; no new "Part number updated" or "Description updated" entry.
